content: .{@-कान्तः, -मणिः@} the moon-stone (supposed to ooze away under the influence of the moon); द्रवति च हिमरश्मावुद्गते चन्द्रकान्तः <ls>U. 6. 12</ls>; <ls>Śi. 4. 58</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 57</ls>; <ls>Bh. 1. 21</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1. 24</ls>. . ({@-तः, -तम्@}) the white eatable water-lily blossoming during the night. . ({@-तम्@}) sandal-wood.
